Sentence (English): We purchased a new home and wanted to upgrade the builder grade applaces.
Comments (English): [ Really great diswasher ] || ---------------- || We purchased a new home and wanted to upgrade the builder grade applaces. I read several reviews and decided to go with Bosch even though it didn't have a heating element to dry the dishes. Surprisingly, Crystal Dry works very well and the dishes come out dryer than they did with the Kitchenaid we had in our old house. No more standing water on the top of the glassware at the end of the cycle. Didn't know if I'd like the sivlerware drawer at the top of the unit, but it works very well and seems to get the silverware cleaner. Sentence (English): Due to the heating element going out and the rinse aid dispenser failing I decided to replace my 14 year old dishwasher before Thanksgiving.
Comments (English): [ Extremely quiet, excellent cleaning dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Due to the heating element going out and the rinse aid dispenser failing I decided to replace my 14 year old dishwasher before Thanksgiving. After reading the reviews on multiple brands of dishwashers, I ultimately decided to go with the Maytag. My history with Maytag has been extremely mixed in the past, due to issues with my Maytag Neptune washer and dryer. but the poor reviews on the other brands helped make my decision. I do feel that the directions on the hookups could be more clear, especially on connecting the water inlet to the machine. It said to hand tighten and then to use a pair of pliers to turn an additional 1/4 to 1/2 turn but not to overly tighten. It is a metal water line connector fastening on to a plastic water valve. Definitely not a very heavy duty plastic piece, among the multiple other plastic pieces in this dishwasher motor assembly. I have installed multiple other dishwashers but this was a new level of difficulty. The electrical plug area wire was not properly extended past the stop valve, was unable to connect the wires, so had to maneuver the cord past it by an inch to attach the wires. Then following the directions to a T on attaching the water line but immediately got an error code with water leaking out as soon as I turned my water valve back on. Tightening it an additional 1/2 turn after cleaning up the leaked water. Started a load of dishes, got through the wash cycle and received another error code with water leaking again. Rinsed dishes by hand, then cleaned up the new flow of water. Then tightened it again by several turns. No new error codes or leaks for over a week. This dishwasher has done an outstanding job of cleaning the dishes, even with small amounts of food left on them when put in the dishwasher, all food has been fully washed off, without any spotting or residue left behind. Extremely quiet while going through the cycles. Love the food catcher at the bottom, very easy to remove and rinse out any small particles left behind. Lots of top rack and bottom rack room for multiple size objects. The large baking sheets can easily fit standing up in the bottom rack and most of the larger pots and pans can fit on the top rack. This is a very good thing since it does not have the adjustable top rack that my other dishwasher had. My biggest concern is the sprayer arm that is attached to the bottom of the top rack, it is silver like it is metal but not positive that it is. It is very flimsy feeling, feels like when you spin it by hand to make sure it is clearing all the dishes on the bottom rack, that it could easily come off. Does not feel that it would last over an extended period. Another negative is that the dispenser does not have a separate slot for adding the Lemonie Shine, which I always used in my other dishwasher and was recommended by a reputable repairman due to our well having hard water. I put the liquid detergent in the dispenser, close the dispenser door, then add a teaspoon or two of the Lemonie Shine on top of the closed dispenser door. Has done a decent job of drying the plastic containers with a few exceptions such as inside the crevices.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. You should definitely bring in the Dishwasher Auntie! We have three babies, and our youngest is a one-year-old who is a total mama's boy. If I stay in the kitchen for too long, he cries and makes a huge fuss, so I can barely cook and can't do the dishes at all. It was so annoying having to do the piled-up dishes while the baby was sleeping. I just wanted to rest, but having to do the dishes made me really frustrated. So, I desperately needed a dishwasher, which is why I ended up choosing this one. I felt burdened by products that were too big, but this model isn't that small either. The interior is spacious, and it fits plenty of dishes—I was surprised. The installation finished quickly, but the cable management was a mess, so I did it myself. I was told I had to organize the water hose myself as well, which was a bit disappointing. It felt like the installation wasn't perfect. Although the finishing touches were a bit lacking, the dishwasher's performance is good. We ate pork belly, and the grease stains came off completely—this was amazing. When I used to wash dishes by hand, I would wipe the pork belly plate with a paper towel and wipe it multiple times. I just put everything in the dishwasher right away, and wow, it cleaned everything squeaky clean. It even polished the kids' lunch trays, which were a mess with dried-out rice grains, spotlessly clean. The spoons are sparkling. Now I understand why people call it "Dishwasher Auntie"—it's just so good. The price isn't too expensive either, so it's not a big burden. If you're looking for an affordable, high-performance dishwasher, I highly recommend this one.

Sentence (English): Heaven!
Comments (English): [ Shockingly Impressive & Efficient ] || ---------------- || Heaven! I have never written a product review until today. This machine warrants a shout out! This is my 5th dishwasher and it was recommended I try a Bosch. I was skeptical at first with the extra cost however, the second I started running it, I was amazed. I do a very quick basic rinse of my dishes and they come out clean! I put my son's filthy 3 day dishes (like the kind with the milk ring) and they come out clean! No first scrub required. The 3rd rack has saved me from running the dishwasher multiple times in a day. Since this provides an extra spot for all the lids and extra small things. We don't use the utensil basket, instead put the silverware on the top shelf and it makes unloading so easy by just grabbing spoons only or forks and dropping into the silverware drawer quicker. Although I haven't gotten my water bill yet, I can tell I am using far less water since I can rely on the machine to get the grime/grease. Shelves are adjustable and once you find the right height for specific items I find I don't move the shelves again. The prongs on the lowest rack are a bit rigid and sometimes hard to hold a stack of lined up bowls, but still playing with the set-up. Super super quiet! And the red light that shines on your kitchen floor when it is running! So cool. Did I mention that there is 6 people in our house and we are doing dishes non-stop! I do recommend using jet-dry to get the dishes extra shiny. Machine goes through jet-dry at a slow pace, old dishwasher tended to drain the tank faster. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS AMAZING MACHINE My kids are sick of me talking about it! Enjoy!

Sentence (English): I have owned many dishwasher, but the inside racks on this one make it difficult to load even basic dishes.
Comments (English): [ Buyer Beware ] || ---------------- || I have owned many dishwasher, but the inside racks on this one make it difficult to load even basic dishes. The tines are too close together and not very tall. We have to run it when it is only about 75% full so that all the dishes can get clean. We cannot stack the dishes very well, and just sort of have to lay them inside the dishwasher. I am in the process of returning this dishwasher. I did not want the "smart" features and was told that I could use the dishwasher without them. That was not the case, as certain functions can only be accessed by connecting the dishwasher to my wifi and an app. This has been a hassle of an experience, as I am having to pay a plumber to install twice and disconnect once. Not to mention the time spent shopping for another dishwasher without smart technology (not available at Lowes). Luckily Lowes is refunding my money when they get the dishwasher back, but only because I paid for it with their credit card. Since I had used it (for only 2 weeks), Lowes was hesitant to refund my money. But how could I have known I wasn't happy with it if I didn't actually use it? If you want a white dishwasher, don't have a lot of dishes to stack, and don't mind using a smart appliance, this might be a fit for you, but it was not for me.

Comments (English): [ Honest review of a purchase I made with my own money ] || ---------------- || 1. Motivation for Purchase. I decided to buy a dishwasher because I felt that the time spent washing dishes was a complete waste. I wanted to reduce the time I always spent on dishwashing and live a more convenient life. 2. Design and Installation. The product I purchased is the LG DIOS Objet Collection 12-place setting dishwasher, and the color was a warm beige tone. Actually, I was expecting a gray color at first, but after it was installed, the color matched my LG refrigerator perfectly, completing a tone-on-tone interior. I actually liked the beige color because it gave the kitchen a warm feeling. Also, thanks to the Kitchen Fit design, the kitchen looked very neat even after installation, which I was satisfied with. I didn't expect the 80,000 won service call fee, but seeing the quality of the finished product, I understood why. 3. Performance and Convenience. The biggest advantage of this product is the automatic setting function. It automatically adjusts the wash intensity and time based on the condition of the dishes, and all I had to do was press the start button! It was really convenient. When the wash was finished, I received a notification on the LG ThinQ app on my phone, so I could check it immediately even while doing other things. 4. Noise and Washing Power. Noise is an important factor, and while it wasn't completely silent, it was definitely not at a level where it was "uncomfortably loud"; it was just background noise, so it didn't bother me. The cleaning power was truly satisfying, and you can be sure about the condition of the dishes after washing by checking the photos yourself. 5. Conclusion. "A choice that captures time saving, interior aesthetics, and convenience!" The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that is comprehensively very satisfying in terms of design, performance, and convenience. The initial cost of 620,000 won (with card discount applied) might be a bit steep if you include the service call fee, but I believe it is well worth the investment considering the time spent on daily dishwashing and the convenience it offers. Sentence (English): This dishwasher came highly recommended by a Lowes salesperson.
Comments (English): [ Beware of tapping noise ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher came highly recommended by a Lowes salesperson. I went in thinking I wanted a LG. After discussing the pros and cons of the two brands, we decided to go with the Kitchenaide. That was the brand of dishwasher we were replacing. Well the dishwasher was installed the day after Thanksgiving. Evidently the installer was in a hurry. He did a halfass job of installing the machine. He left Styrofoam piece separating 2 shelves and did not install one of the sprayer arms. The plastic film was still on it. My husband was able to fix those items, but the machine still made a tapping sound during certain cycles. So I finally get an installer to come back out on Tuesday to take a look at the install. Everything was hooked up correctly. The sound we were hearing was the sprayer stirring up the soap with an agitator like on a washing machine. This evidently is normal on these new dishwashers made by Kitchenaide and Whirlpool. The machine also has a db rating of 44, but I think it sounds louder than our old machine. Plus the tapping noise is very annoying. I wish someone at Lowes would have told us this feature. I probably would have gone with a Bosch or LG. If your kitchen is in a separate part of the house, this may not be a big deal. Our kitchen and family room are an open concept. Oh, and the top 3rd rack is basically useless. It is so tiny of an area. It is good only for big silverware serving pieces and maybe some ramikins.

It's a manufactured defect that the company should really improve their quality checks before shipping out. Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher Dec 2023, installed Feb 2024.
Comments (English): [ 10 month review ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher Dec 2023, installed Feb 2024. Overall, I have been happy with it. The one issue I ran into was in July 2024. An F8/E4 error code came up and water was leaking into the overflow tray. Since I've had it less than 1 year, Whirlpool covered the repairs. It did take almost 1 month to finally get the proper repairs due to an initial misdiagnosis (technician thought it was an oversudsing issue when it was actually a gasket failure in the lower left corner of the machine). The gasket was replaced and also the spray arm since the technician noticed it was slightly bent and likely causing unnecessary wave pressure on the seal which caused the gasket to fail. If it wasn't for this issue, I would have rated the dishwasher 5 stars. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning performance, drying capability, design layout, and low noise level. I do want to emphasize that I use rinse aid to help with drying, thus I cannot attest to the drying capabilities in the absence of that product.

It washes and dries the dishes really well. When I open the door after a cleaning the dishes are super clean and very hot, and dry. The racks are spacious and easy to put the dishes in. I like the third top rack for things like spatulas and other flatter cooking utensils. The control panel is not complicated. There is a one hour sequence, with normal or heavy as choices- and I have only used normal so far. It is very quiet, and has a nice little sound when it is finished running the load. Hopefully it will last longer than the last one!

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.<배송, 설치에 관하여>우선, 어제 설치를 받았습니다.친절하신 기사님이 전화를 주셨고제가 아이 하교 데리러 가는 시간에딱 걸렸는데 최대한 빨리 와주셔서가시고 정리까지 하고 아이를 하교 시켰습니다.그리고 저희 집 정수기 설치하다가뭐를 건드리면서싱크대 아래 수도관과정수기 연결 밸브가 제대로 맞물리지않아 물이 새고 고생하고땀을 흘리고 애쓰시다 가셨는데이번에 오셨을 때 그런 일이 있었다고 말씀드렸는데수도 안건드린다고 하시더니정수기 급수 줄 중간으로 Y자 연결하셔서30초만에 하시더라고요.그게 불안해서 저는 그동안 식기세척기를못사고 정수기 만 3년 지났는데도교체 못하고 있었거든요.지난 번 너무 걱정되었어서요.그런데 이번 설치기사님은베테랑이셨어요.싱크대 상판 대리석도 굳이 구멍 안내시고가스관이 들어간 곳으로 쑥 넣으시더니싱크대 안에 그릇이 잔뜩  들어있는데그릇에 닿지도 않게(솔직히 바깥 작업하던 옷으로그릇 닿으면 제 옷이어도 그리 상쾌하진않잖아요) 순식간에 줄을 빼내시더라고요.암튼 설치가 완벽했습니다.------------------------------<문제 발생~!!!!!과 자체 해결>저 같은 덜렁이나 생길 수 있는 문제겠지마구매 전 참고하시라고 올려보아요.제가 주방 상부장과 싱크대 대리석 사이높이를 2번 정확히 측정했는데52cm 였어요.식기세척기는 세로50cm라고 나와있어서완벽히 맞춤이다! 생각했는데요...이런....설치 끝났는데 밀어 넣으려니 상부장에 끼어 안밀리는 거에요.제가 2번이나 쟀어서 생각하고 생각했는데줄자가 그 상부장에 들어있어서 줄자를 꺼내면서상부장 문을 열고 쟀던거에요.상부장 문은 상부장보다 2cm정도 더 내려와있더라고요.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!길이를 재실 때 <너무 당연한 이야기를말씀드려 창피하지만>상부장 문을 닫고 측정하셔야 합니다.!!!!또한 미끄럼 방지로 식기세척기 하단에발처럼 흡착고무를 붙여주시는데그거를 떼어내도 안들어가더라고요.상부장 닫고 52cm는 되어야 아주 딱 들어갈 것같아요.우선 설치를 다 했고급수, 배수관까지 다 꽂은 상태이고식기세척기는 사용하고 싶어서고민고민하다가상부장 문을 거기만 떼어내기로남편과 결정했어요.(사진 첨부^^)상부장에 붙은 경첩까지 다 떼어내면좋을 것 같은데남편이 나중에 다시 문 붙이려면그 자리 다시 그대로 경첩 박으면 헐거워져 헛돌수도 있다고 그냥 두재서(저희 둘 다 금손이 아니고 이런 거 어설퍼서요)그냥 뒀는데 보다가 영 아니면나사 돌려 경첩도 빼버리려고요.<식기세척기용 세제 없음>요건 좀 아쉽던데 1회분이라도 살짝샘플로 있으면 좋을텐데...없어서 어제 바로 돌려보지 못했어요.건조기를 샀을 때는건조기 시트를 3장 주셔서 들어있을 줄 알았거든요.암튼 어제 식세기 설치 후 싱크대 문짝 분리, 식기세척기 세제쿠팡으로 배송받아서오늘 오후 도착. 저녁 먹고첫 식세기 돌려봤어요.<식기세척기 첫 사용>문을 열고 문짝에 세제를 넣는 거였고밥이나 음식 들어가는 곳을 아래로 향하게넣라고 써있어서 그랬어요.음식 찌꺼기가 있으면막힐 것 같아물로 음식은 싹 털어내고 넣었고첨이라 겁나서 60도로 돌렸는데돌아가는 소음이 크지 않으며끝나니 자동 문이 열려서 너무나 좋았어요.밥 먹고 대신 해서설거지 해주니 진짜 편하더라고요.ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 괜히 신나더라고요.쿠팡체험단을 통해 제공받은 물품이지만쿠팡의 리뷰를 통해 소비자와 쿠팡이 같이 성장한다고생각하기에 전문적이지는 않아도진솔하게 리뷰를 남겼습니다.

Sentence (English): The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): I was so worried last time.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): Oh no.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.
