Sentence (English): Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): I was excited for no reason.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. <About delivery and installation> First of all, I had it installed yesterday. The friendly technician called me, and it was just in time for me to pick up my child from school, so he came as quickly as possible, cleaned up, and dropped my child off at school. Then, while installing our water purifier, he touched something and the valve connecting the water pipe under the sink to the water purifier did not engage properly, causing water to leak. I told him about the same thing when he came this time, but he said he wouldn't touch the water pipe, and he connected the water purifier supply line in a Y shape in the middle and did it in 30 seconds. Because of that anxiety, I couldn't buy a dishwasher, and I haven't replaced the water purifier even though it's been 3 years. I was so worried last time. But this installer was a veteran. He didn't bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop of the sink, and he put it right where the gas pipe goes. There were a lot of dishes in the sink, but he didn't even touch the dishes (honestly, (It wouldn't be very pleasant even if it were my clothes if I touched the dishes with the clothes I worked with outside) He pulled out the string in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ----------------------------<Problem occurred~! And solved it myself> I'm posting this for reference before purchasing because it's a problem that could occur to someone like me. I measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the marble of the sink twice and it was exactly 52cm. The dishwasher is 50cm in height, so I thought it would fit perfectly! Oh no. After the installation was finished, when I tried to push it in, it got caught in the upper cabinet and wouldn't slide. I thought and thought because I measured twice, but the tape measure was in the upper cabinet, so I took the tape measure out, opened the upper cabinet door, and measured. The upper cabinet door was about 2cm lower than the upper cabinet. When measuring the length, <I'm embarrassed to say such an obvious thing, but> you should close the upper cabinet door and measure. Also, to prevent slipping, they put suction rubber feet on the bottom of the dishwasher, but even after removing them, it wouldn't go in. I think it would fit perfectly if the upper cabinet was closed and it was about 52cm deep. First of all, I finished installing it and connected the water supply and drain pipes, and I wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to just take off the upper cabinet door there. (Photo attached^^) I think it would be good to take off all the hinges on the upper cabinet, but my husband said that if he were to reattach the door later, the hinges would come loose and spin around if he put them back in place (neither of us are skilled at this kind of thing), so we just left it, but if it doesn't work, we're going to turn the screws and take out the hinges as well. <No dishwasher detergent> This is a bit disappointing, but it would be nice to have a small sample, even if it's just one dose. I didn't have any so I couldn't use it right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave me three dryer sheets so I thought it would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday, I removed the sink door and had dishwasher detergent delivered by Coupang, which arrived this afternoon. I ran the dishwasher for the first time after dinner. <First time using a dishwasher> I opened the door and poured detergent into the door, and it said to put it in with the rice or food part facing down, so I did that. I was worried that food residue would clog the dryer, so I shook out all the food with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was scared so I turned it on at 60 degrees, but the noise it made wasn't that loud and the automatic door opened when it was done, which was great. It was really convenient because it did the dishes for me after I finished eating. I was excited for no reason. Although I received this product through the Coupang Experience Group, I left an honest review even though I'm not a professional because I believe that consumers and Coupang grow together through Coupang reviews.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.<배송, 설치에 관하여>우선, 어제 설치를 받았습니다.친절하신 기사님이 전화를 주셨고제가 아이 하교 데리러 가는 시간에딱 걸렸는데 최대한 빨리 와주셔서가시고 정리까지 하고 아이를 하교 시켰습니다.그리고 저희 집 정수기 설치하다가뭐를 건드리면서싱크대 아래 수도관과정수기 연결 밸브가 제대로 맞물리지않아 물이 새고 고생하고땀을 흘리고 애쓰시다 가셨는데이번에 오셨을 때 그런 일이 있었다고 말씀드렸는데수도 안건드린다고 하시더니정수기 급수 줄 중간으로 Y자 연결하셔서30초만에 하시더라고요.그게 불안해서 저는 그동안 식기세척기를못사고 정수기 만 3년 지났는데도교체 못하고 있었거든요.지난 번 너무 걱정되었어서요.그런데 이번 설치기사님은베테랑이셨어요.싱크대 상판 대리석도 굳이 구멍 안내시고가스관이 들어간 곳으로 쑥 넣으시더니싱크대 안에 그릇이 잔뜩  들어있는데그릇에 닿지도 않게(솔직히 바깥 작업하던 옷으로그릇 닿으면 제 옷이어도 그리 상쾌하진않잖아요) 순식간에 줄을 빼내시더라고요.암튼 설치가 완벽했습니다.------------------------------<문제 발생~!!!!!과 자체 해결>저 같은 덜렁이나 생길 수 있는 문제겠지마구매 전 참고하시라고 올려보아요.제가 주방 상부장과 싱크대 대리석 사이높이를 2번 정확히 측정했는데52cm 였어요.식기세척기는 세로50cm라고 나와있어서완벽히 맞춤이다! 생각했는데요...이런....설치 끝났는데 밀어 넣으려니 상부장에 끼어 안밀리는 거에요.제가 2번이나 쟀어서 생각하고 생각했는데줄자가 그 상부장에 들어있어서 줄자를 꺼내면서상부장 문을 열고 쟀던거에요.상부장 문은 상부장보다 2cm정도 더 내려와있더라고요.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!길이를 재실 때 <너무 당연한 이야기를말씀드려 창피하지만>상부장 문을 닫고 측정하셔야 합니다.!!!!또한 미끄럼 방지로 식기세척기 하단에발처럼 흡착고무를 붙여주시는데그거를 떼어내도 안들어가더라고요.상부장 닫고 52cm는 되어야 아주 딱 들어갈 것같아요.우선 설치를 다 했고급수, 배수관까지 다 꽂은 상태이고식기세척기는 사용하고 싶어서고민고민하다가상부장 문을 거기만 떼어내기로남편과 결정했어요.(사진 첨부^^)상부장에 붙은 경첩까지 다 떼어내면좋을 것 같은데남편이 나중에 다시 문 붙이려면그 자리 다시 그대로 경첩 박으면 헐거워져 헛돌수도 있다고 그냥 두재서(저희 둘 다 금손이 아니고 이런 거 어설퍼서요)그냥 뒀는데 보다가 영 아니면나사 돌려 경첩도 빼버리려고요.<식기세척기용 세제 없음>요건 좀 아쉽던데 1회분이라도 살짝샘플로 있으면 좋을텐데...없어서 어제 바로 돌려보지 못했어요.건조기를 샀을 때는건조기 시트를 3장 주셔서 들어있을 줄 알았거든요.암튼 어제 식세기 설치 후 싱크대 문짝 분리, 식기세척기 세제쿠팡으로 배송받아서오늘 오후 도착. 저녁 먹고첫 식세기 돌려봤어요.<식기세척기 첫 사용>문을 열고 문짝에 세제를 넣는 거였고밥이나 음식 들어가는 곳을 아래로 향하게넣라고 써있어서 그랬어요.음식 찌꺼기가 있으면막힐 것 같아물로 음식은 싹 털어내고 넣었고첨이라 겁나서 60도로 돌렸는데돌아가는 소음이 크지 않으며끝나니 자동 문이 열려서 너무나 좋았어요.밥 먹고 대신 해서설거지 해주니 진짜 편하더라고요.ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 괜히 신나더라고요.쿠팡체험단을 통해 제공받은 물품이지만쿠팡의 리뷰를 통해 소비자와 쿠팡이 같이 성장한다고생각하기에 전문적이지는 않아도진솔하게 리뷰를 남겼습니다.

Sentence (English): First of all, I had the installation done yesterday.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): I was just so worried about the last time.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): They pulled the cord out in an instant.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit!
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.
