Sentence (English): When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): <First Dishwasher Use>.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): I was actually excited for no reason.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.<배송, 설치에 관하여>우선, 어제 설치를 받았습니다.친절하신 기사님이 전화를 주셨고제가 아이 하교 데리러 가는 시간에딱 걸렸는데 최대한 빨리 와주셔서가시고 정리까지 하고 아이를 하교 시켰습니다.그리고 저희 집 정수기 설치하다가뭐를 건드리면서싱크대 아래 수도관과정수기 연결 밸브가 제대로 맞물리지않아 물이 새고 고생하고땀을 흘리고 애쓰시다 가셨는데이번에 오셨을 때 그런 일이 있었다고 말씀드렸는데수도 안건드린다고 하시더니정수기 급수 줄 중간으로 Y자 연결하셔서30초만에 하시더라고요.그게 불안해서 저는 그동안 식기세척기를못사고 정수기 만 3년 지났는데도교체 못하고 있었거든요.지난 번 너무 걱정되었어서요.그런데 이번 설치기사님은베테랑이셨어요.싱크대 상판 대리석도 굳이 구멍 안내시고가스관이 들어간 곳으로 쑥 넣으시더니싱크대 안에 그릇이 잔뜩  들어있는데그릇에 닿지도 않게(솔직히 바깥 작업하던 옷으로그릇 닿으면 제 옷이어도 그리 상쾌하진않잖아요) 순식간에 줄을 빼내시더라고요.암튼 설치가 완벽했습니다.------------------------------<문제 발생~!!!!!과 자체 해결>저 같은 덜렁이나 생길 수 있는 문제겠지마구매 전 참고하시라고 올려보아요.제가 주방 상부장과 싱크대 대리석 사이높이를 2번 정확히 측정했는데52cm 였어요.식기세척기는 세로50cm라고 나와있어서완벽히 맞춤이다! 생각했는데요...이런....설치 끝났는데 밀어 넣으려니 상부장에 끼어 안밀리는 거에요.제가 2번이나 쟀어서 생각하고 생각했는데줄자가 그 상부장에 들어있어서 줄자를 꺼내면서상부장 문을 열고 쟀던거에요.상부장 문은 상부장보다 2cm정도 더 내려와있더라고요.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!길이를 재실 때 <너무 당연한 이야기를말씀드려 창피하지만>상부장 문을 닫고 측정하셔야 합니다.!!!!또한 미끄럼 방지로 식기세척기 하단에발처럼 흡착고무를 붙여주시는데그거를 떼어내도 안들어가더라고요.상부장 닫고 52cm는 되어야 아주 딱 들어갈 것같아요.우선 설치를 다 했고급수, 배수관까지 다 꽂은 상태이고식기세척기는 사용하고 싶어서고민고민하다가상부장 문을 거기만 떼어내기로남편과 결정했어요.(사진 첨부^^)상부장에 붙은 경첩까지 다 떼어내면좋을 것 같은데남편이 나중에 다시 문 붙이려면그 자리 다시 그대로 경첩 박으면 헐거워져 헛돌수도 있다고 그냥 두재서(저희 둘 다 금손이 아니고 이런 거 어설퍼서요)그냥 뒀는데 보다가 영 아니면나사 돌려 경첩도 빼버리려고요.<식기세척기용 세제 없음>요건 좀 아쉽던데 1회분이라도 살짝샘플로 있으면 좋을텐데...없어서 어제 바로 돌려보지 못했어요.건조기를 샀을 때는건조기 시트를 3장 주셔서 들어있을 줄 알았거든요.암튼 어제 식세기 설치 후 싱크대 문짝 분리, 식기세척기 세제쿠팡으로 배송받아서오늘 오후 도착. 저녁 먹고첫 식세기 돌려봤어요.<식기세척기 첫 사용>문을 열고 문짝에 세제를 넣는 거였고밥이나 음식 들어가는 곳을 아래로 향하게넣라고 써있어서 그랬어요.음식 찌꺼기가 있으면막힐 것 같아물로 음식은 싹 털어내고 넣었고첨이라 겁나서 60도로 돌렸는데돌아가는 소음이 크지 않으며끝나니 자동 문이 열려서 너무나 좋았어요.밥 먹고 대신 해서설거지 해주니 진짜 편하더라고요.ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 괜히 신나더라고요.쿠팡체험단을 통해 제공받은 물품이지만쿠팡의 리뷰를 통해 소비자와 쿠팡이 같이 성장한다고생각하기에 전문적이지는 않아도진솔하게 리뷰를 남겼습니다.

Sentence (English): Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. <Regarding Delivery and Installation>. First of all, I had the installation done yesterday. A kind technician called me. I arrived right on time to pick up my child from school, but he came as quickly as possible. After he left, I finished tidying up and picked up my child. He had previously struggled and sweated a lot while installing our water purifier; he bumped into something, causing the water pipe under the sink and the purifier's connection valve to leak because they didn't fit properly. When he came this time, I mentioned that incident, but he said he wouldn't touch the water supply. He connected a Y-connector through the middle of the water supply line and finished the job in just 30 seconds. Because of that, I hadn't been able to buy a dishwasher or replace the water purifier even though it had been over three years. I was just so worried about the last time. However, this technician was a veteran. He didn't even bother to drill a hole in the marble countertop; he just slid right in through where the gas pipe went. Even though the sink was full of dishes... Make sure it doesn't even touch the dishes. (Honestly, wearing clothes I used for outdoor work. It doesn't feel very pleasant if the dishes touch them, even if they are my own clothes.) They pulled the cord out in an instant. Anyway, the installation was perfect. ------------------------------. <Problem Occurred~! and Self-Solved>. It might be a problem that only a clumsy person like me would encounter, but I am posting this for your reference before purchasing. I accurately measured the height between the kitchen upper cabinet and the countertop marble twice, and it was 52cm. The dishwasher specifications stated the vertical length was 50cm, so I thought it was a perfect fit! But oh no. The installation was finished, and when I tried to push it in, it got stuck in the upper cabinet and wouldn't budge. Since I had measured it twice, I thought and thought about it. The measuring tape was inside that upper cabinet, so I had measured with the cabinet door open while taking it out. The upper cabinet door was actually about 2cm lower than the cabinet itself. When measuring lengths, <I am embarrassed to state something so obvious, but> you must measure with the upper cabinet door closed. Also, for anti-slip purposes, on the bottom of the dishwasher... They attached suction cups like feet, but even after removing them, it wouldn't fit. I think it will only fit perfectly if the upper cabinet is closed and the height is at least 52cm. First off, the installation is complete, and the water supply and drain pipes are all connected. I really wanted to use the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, my husband and I decided to remove just that part of the upper cabinet door. (Photo attached^^). I thought it would be better to remove all the hinges attached to the upper cabinet as well, but my husband said that if we reattach the door later, screwing the hinges back in the same spot might cause them to become loose and spin freely, so we should just leave it as is. (Neither of us is handy; we're clumsy with things like this.) We just left it as is, but if it really doesn't look good, I'm planning to unscrew the hinges and remove them too. <No dishwasher detergent included>. That was a bit disappointing; it would have been nice to have a small sample, even just for one use. Since there wasn't one, I couldn't run a cycle right away yesterday. When I bought the dryer, they gave us three dryer sheets, so I assumed this would be included. Anyway, after installing the dishwasher yesterday... Detached the sink cabinet door and dishwasher detergent. I had it delivered via Coupang, and it arrived this afternoon. After dinner, I ran the dishwasher for the first time. <First Dishwasher Use>. I was supposed to open the door and put the detergent in the door panel. The instructions said to place it with the food/rice tray facing downwards, so I did that. I was worried it might clog if there were food scraps, so I rinsed everything out with water before putting it in. Since it was my first time, I was nervous and set it to 60 degrees. The noise wasn't loud, and the door opened automatically when it finished, which was so nice. It was really convenient having the dishes washed for me after dinner. I was actually excited for no reason. Although this item was provided through the Coupang Experience Group, I believe that through Coupang reviews, both consumers and Coupang grow together. Therefore, I left a sincere review, even if it isn't professional.

Sentence (English): I urgently ordered a dishwasher because my hands were hurting.
Comments (English): [ great ] || ---------------- || I urgently ordered a dishwasher because my hands were hurting. I debated getting a built-in model but decided on a 6-place setting dishwasher. I wondered if I really needed it, but it is so convenient and great. At first, I didn't know how to stack things, so not much fit in. But it seems like I'm getting the hang of it the more I use it. Since I can just quickly throw it in and only clean up when I go out, it saves time and my legs don't hurt. There really is a reason why housewives recommend this! It's the best! Make sure the spoons don't overlap! When installing it, try placing it in various spots before deciding. I am slightly regretting my choice. I should have tried positioning it this way and that and chosen a direction that made my movement easier. That's my regret.

Reason for Purchase: My wrists were bothering me after giving birth to my second child, and they gradually worsened to the point where it was difficult to even hold cutlery. I was told that the best way to heal them was to avoid using them, so I pondered what I could do to reduce strain and decided to purchase a dishwasher. 2. Reason for Purchasing This Product: Since I live in an older 24-pyeong apartment, a built-in model would sacrifice storage space, which was a significant burden. Cons: Two days after I bought it, the price dropped by 40,000 won? I feel like I got ripped off somehow. It's probably just my imagination, right? 5. Willingness to repurchase if it breaks: 100%

Comments (English): [ If you have bad wrists, you absolutely must buy this! ] || ---------------- || 1. Reason for Purchase: My wrists were bothering me after giving birth to my second child, and they gradually worsened to the point where it was difficult to even hold cutlery. I was told that the best way to heal them was to avoid using them, so I pondered what I could do to reduce strain and decided to purchase a dishwasher. 2. Reason for Purchasing This Product: Since I live in an older 24-pyeong apartment, a built-in model would sacrifice storage space, which was a significant burden. I looked into countertop models; while there are various brands, most were OEM or ODM. Therefore, I decided it was best to purchase a Samsung product because of the ease of after-sales service. 3. Advantages: 1) If you are good at "Tetris" (assembling the pieces) and choose the right detergent, the cleaning power is excellent. I previously used a 4-person capacity product from a smaller company, but the Samsung product cleans much better than just relying on the detergent. 2) Chopsticks do not easily fall out of the cutlery holder. While they sometimes come out if you roughly shove them in, the previous product from a smaller company was unusable to the point where I had to remove the holder entirely. With the Samsung product, you don't even need to wash cutlery. 3) Washing baby bottles is also no problem. I just run it with regular dishes, and they come out well-cleaned. 4) The standard mode only takes 1 hour, so it's great for running frequently. 5) I really like that the door opens automatically when finished. The product I used before required me to open it manually every time. 6) Since it is all stainless steel, it is durable and dries quickly. 7) The design is very pretty! 8) The noise level is very low for a countertop. 4. Cons: Two days after I bought it, the price dropped by 40,000 won? I feel like I got ripped off somehow. It's probably just my imagination, right? 5. Willingness to repurchase if it breaks: 100%

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher last month, and had it installed today.
Comments (English): [ Noisy, Bad design, and Waste of Money ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher last month, and had it installed today. The Design: From outside, dishwashers look almost the same. Inside and rack design is what makes the difference. In that aspect, this dishwasher fails badly. In particular, the bottom rack is simply very poorly designed. It cannot hold enough dishes. I even tried to see if the bottom rack from my old dishwasher would fit, but it didn't.The noise: This dishwasher is billed as LoDecible. What a pathetic joke. The noise level is not 42 dB. Measured 3 feet away, it is always above 46 dB during regular operation and much higher during filling or discharging. When you are right next to the machine, the noise could get to up to 58 dB during normal operation. My 15 years old previous dishwasher was quieter, even as it was falling apart. For reference, I attach the screenshot below which is from 3 ft away.Installation: The installation was not smooth at all. Here in Massachusetts, the installers charged me $100 to move an outlet by 2 feet, even though the dishwasher had a dedicated GFCI breaker. They had not disclosed the charge before hand.Bottom-line: I am very much disappointed and unhappy with this machine. It will go back before the three-month return window is up.

Sentence (English): Installation was very simple.
Comments (English): [ Good buy ] || ---------------- || Installation was very simple. I appreciate that the power cord is detachable, so you can run it through conduits to the connection point. It washes dishes very well, it is reasonably quiet and the smart functions via app are quite useful. I particularly like the possibility of programming it, both via app and through the buttons on the front, to start at a certain time and thus be able to use the cheaper night rates. The cutlery tray initially gets a little stuck when folding it back into the dishwasher but with use this problem is disappearing. It replaces a dishwasher that had been in operation for 30 years but was very noisy and no longer washed very well. I hope this one gives us many years of good service.
Comments (Original): [ Buena compra ] || ---------------- || La instalación fue muy sencilla. Se agradece que el cable de alimentación es desmontable, para pasarlo por conductos hasta el punto de conexión.Lave muy bien la vajilla, es razonablemente silencioso y las funciones inteligentes via app son bastante útiles. En particular me gusta la posibilidad de programarlo, tanto via app como a través de las teclas del frontal, para que arranque a una hora determinada y así poder hacer uso de las tarifas nocturnas más económicas.La bandeja de cubiertos inicialmente se queda un poco enganchada a la hora de replegarla dentro del lavavajillas pero con el uso está desapareciendo ese problema.Sustituye un lavavajillas que llevaba 30 años en funcionamiento pero hacía mucho ruido y ya no lavaba muy bien. Espero que este nos dé muchos años de buen servicio.

I'm thinking it was probably the loud pop (spark) when he was testing the dispensor. He had to order new parts and will be back this week to install more parts, not sure why we bought this overpriced over hyped dishwasher other than my wife says it matches the refrigerator and of course I now need to buy the matching range. Don't waste your money, just buy the average $600 dishwasher- you'll thank me later!

Sentence (English): Prior KitchenAid dishwasher lasted nearly 15 years and required only minor repairs.
Comments (English): [ Worked well until it didn\u2019t, repair service blues ] || ---------------- || Prior KitchenAid dishwasher lasted nearly 15 years and required only minor repairs. Purchased KitchenAid model KDFE204KPS dishwasher in October 2021. Declined the extended warranty offer because so often they are a waste of money. Big mistake! After three years of regular use, found water pooled in the bottom of the dishwasher one morning in late October 2024. The control panel was completely unresponsive. No lights. A three-year old mid-level dishwasher should not have such problems though I know quality control for so many electronic parts is a big challenge.Scheduled a “fixed price” repair service through Whirlpool Customer Care. Work is guaranteed for 90 days. Factory certified repair technician came out, removed racks, did some testing, said I'd need a new control panel and to allow 7-10 days for the part to come in. Repair technician returned to install new control panel, removed racks and took dishwasher apart only to discover an issue with the “wiring harness” too. Another 7-10 day wait for the parts. (They get their parts from a distributor, not directly from Whirlpool.)Repair technician returned for the THIRD time two days before Thanksgiving, removed racks, took the dishwasher apart (again) and installed the new parts. Got to run exactly three loads of dishes then discovered upper wash arm sitting in the bottom rack after breakfast yesterday. Unbelievable! Could not get it screwed back on to the under side of the middle rack. The part is “an assembly”. We believe it was damaged during repairs.Called the factory authorized repair service. “You have to schedule through your warranty provider.” Huh? I thought they guaranteed their work. Got the impression that they wanted to treat this as a separate incident. Called Whirlpool Customer Care (again), when a human came on the line I explained everything, was transferred to Fixed Price Repair Department, explained everything for a second time. Both customer care reps were clearly US based, polite and apologetic. Their process is to contact the repair technician and confirm what was done. Somebody will reach out to me within 24 hours with a resolution. Meanwhile, my polite but firm letter to the Whirlpool CEO triggered a phone call. Given all that I have been through, if I am ready to give up on my current dishwasher, Whirlpool will give me a significant discount on a replacement. I believe KitchenAid does stand behind their products and tries to do the right thing, it is just that like many large companies, they have bureaucratic processes. We'll see what resolution is offered. Meanwhile, I am contemplating the discount offer, while continuing to wash dishes the old fashioned way.

Sentence (English): We are a family of four living in a rented apartment, so I didn't think a built-in dishwasher would work.
Comments (English): We are a family of four living in a rented apartment, so I didn't think a built-in dishwasher would work. I looked into countertop models and came across the Samsung one. The reviews were excellent, and it seemed trustworthy, so I decided to buy it. I pre-washed the dishes to remove any solid food particles and ran the cycle. It indicated a standard time of 1 hour and 8 minutes, and after hearing the sound of water, it started working. It seemed to drain water about 2 or 3 times. Looking at the amount of water coming out, it was significantly less than the amount I usually run while washing dishes. I wondered if such a small amount would be enough to clean them, but the dishes came out incredibly clean. It works very well. The 6-place setting fits plenty of dishes, and I am very satisfied because I no longer have to wash dishes with a sore wrist. The installer was kind and installed it on the date I requested. I wish I had bought this sooner; I wonder why I struggled for so long. It is great that my husband and I no longer fight over the dishes. I can use the time spent washing dishes to do other chores or teach the kids, and our dinner time has become much more relaxed. ^^ It's the best. (If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"^^)
