Sentence (English): From day one I found immediate leaking from the lose door seal.
Comments (English): [ Not Worth One Star ] || ---------------- || From day one I found immediate leaking from the lose door seal. I called GE and their tech told me, "This is the cheapest we make, it's all plastic." He used his finger to punch the door seal back into place. I have done the same for months but now the seal is so dysfunctional the door leaks constantly. Unfortunately I wash dishes only once a week and despite only having the washer four months and only using at night I was unaware of the increasing flood volume. I only discovered how bad it was when one morning a huge pool of water in the middle of the kitchen floor with dried detergent power around an evaporated larger pool led me to investigate the origin. I ran the dishwasher in daylight and watched (and filmed) water dripping out of the door. Now my laminate kitchen floor is ruined and it , plus the subfloor need replacing. It has been slow, insidious, and hard to discover because I only use it once a week. In addition the racks are cheap. The bottom rack features small plastic wheels that regularly pop off and have to be replaced. There is no track so I have to constantly lift the rack to place it back into the washer, which is difficult with two shoulder replacements). If the bottom rack is empty it pops all over, slides sideways, and must be manually replaced into the machine. All-in-all, a cheap, terrible, yet expensive machine.

Sentence (English): First, this dishwasher cleans and dries better than any other I've ever owned.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well but is quirky ] || ---------------- || First, this dishwasher cleans and dries better than any other I've ever owned. Seriously, I have teenagers that load pretty dirty dishes and they come out clean. Now to the quirks. I'm not a fan of how close together the tines are for loading dishes. It only works if every plate is exactly the same (which is not the case) so if one is slightly bending forward then the water can't pass between them and the plate doesn't get clean. I go around this by loading every other spot (which works great) but defeats the purpose of putting them that close together. The door is not very solid. It creates a great seal but the door itself isn't very solid so it tweaks sometimes when closing. This means the dishwasher won't start because the door isn't closed all the way but you can't tell that by looking. You have to open and close it by holding the middle of the door. Our old one (LG) wasn't like that so this is something to get used to. The last and most quirky feature of all is the control panel. There is a delay between pushing the button and hearing the sound that the button has been pushed. Since there is no other indicator that the button has been pushed, you can push it a few times before you can tell if it worked. Since the "start" and "pause" button is the same, you can't tell if you've pushed "start" or if you pushed it twice and it is paused. When we first got it, we came back to a "paused" dishwasher hours after we started it. I have come to rely on the app to help determine if it's actually running but again, this is a changed from the previous dishwasher so it's annoying to have to go to the app to see if it's running. All factors considered, I would buy this dishwasher again because it excels in the primary function of actually cleaning the dishes but my husband finds the quirks too annoying and would not buy it again.

Sentence (English): One thing that is important to me is NOT using any smart home nonsense for security reasons.
Comments (English): [ Don't need to use "smart" features - Good quality ] || ---------------- || One thing that is important to me is NOT using any smart home nonsense for security reasons. I have never attempted to hook this to the internet and it doesn't bug me to connect like some other products. If you are concerned about internet security and privacy you know that many devices, such as "Smart" TVs, annoy you to connect it to the internet because it wants to sell your information (this is why they are so cheap, they get like 10$ a year selling your information). This is a dishwasher, I want to push a button and have it clean my dishes. I don't need it reporting back to Bosch so they can sell how frequently I run the dishwasher to some sketchy databroker which in turn can tell a detergent company when to push ads to me. You can try and work around it with a PiHole etc. but it is best to just never hook it up. Why would I trust a home appliance company to be "hacker proof" when internet security companies can't do it? Know that you can safely buy this and ignore that it has a WIFI modem in itAs a dishwasher, it works well, and is VERY quiet. I don't mind the top controls as much as I thought I would. It is a little weird to hit "start" and then close the door but you get used to it shortly. There is a mode where it opens the door after the cycle is done to air dry automatically which I like although it was surprising the first time it happened. There is a little red light it projects onto the floor to let you know it is working because it is so quiet, you won't know otherwise.I have only had it for a week so I can't speak to longevity but our last Bosch lasted for at least 20 years and the one problem we had with it was easy to address for someone with even a moderate amount of handiness. This being a more premium model I hope it hasn't been cost reduced at the expense of longevity. Based on the visible build quality though, it seems excellent. Some of the higher end models have unique things such as sprayer head which I worry would be hard to source replacements for10ish years from now if there are problems. That is why I chose this model. The 3rd rack is awesome as well. Silverware goes up there for me and it cleans well and really opens up the bottom 2 racks. Everyone who has seen it was very jealous. I suppose I must hang out with pretty lame people who are impressed by dishwasher racks but it really is quite practical.Based on what I have seen so far, I expect to outlive this dishwasher but maybe not by much.

Sentence (English): The Bosch 800 series diswasher is an excellent machinge that really gets the dishes clean.
Comments (English): [ Cleaner dishes ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 800 series diswasher is an excellent machinge that really gets the dishes clean. No more prerinsing before loading the machine. It has lots of adjustable prongs and racks for ease of loading multiple items. My only complaint was that there was not a user manual included with the purchase and I had to download it an print it myself. Also there are symbols that appear on the display that you literally have to google to figure out since the symbols are not pictured in the instructions book and all that its telling you is it needs rinse aid. It took awhile to realize that you don't just push the buttons and then start as I was told by the installer, but instead must push a power button first. It would have been extremely beneficial to have had an easy start insert to figure some of these things out -- This is why I am only giving a 4 star rating.

While I still believe that Kitchenaid has one of the best dishwasher brands overall, If it wasn't for the hassle and cost of un-install - re-install, I would return this particular unit and find a design that better fits the type of dishes that we wash most often. Sentence (English): Installation was a problem that should not exist.
Comments (English): [ A good solid 4 so far. ] || ---------------- || Installation was a problem that should not exist. A 90 degree 3/4 to 3/8 adapter was needed to attach the water. The Bosch washer it replaced had a 3/8 port installed as standard. The 3/8 hose is the most standard hose connection. To design the water entry with a 3/4 inlet, garden hose, connection is dumb. The internal electrical box and connector were also a problem. You cannot run wires through sheet metal without either a grommet or a cable clamp. One of those two should have been installed at the factory. The terminal block in the electrical box is a very poor design. The terminals on the washer side have a cutout for the wires to have ring terminals attached. The terminals on the incoming side have an offset cutout so the ring terminals cannot be connected. If the cutouts would have been in the center of the terminal ring terminals or bare wire could have been attached. Both of these items show very sloppy engineering. The documentation has the same poor quality. I just hope that the washer performs long term and that I do not find poor engineering later when it malfunctions.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher was delivered just as the gas range installer was visiting.
Comments (English): The dishwasher was delivered just as the gas range installer was visiting. The technician was eyeing the dishwasher more than the gas installation, saying he would drill a hole in the sink to install it. No matter how much I told him that this model doesn't require drilling and he could install it himself, he wouldn't budge. So I opened the instruction manual and showed him that there was a drill-free method among the two options. He looked shocked. (He seemed disappointed, as if he had been hoping to get a job done while he was there). It’s a simple installation; all you need is a power cord. The only downside is that I would have been totally thrilled if they had included a 1-2 washout supply of detergent with the initial delivery. I had to buy detergent, and since the local supermarket only had liquid detergent (I searched all three places), I was impatient waiting for powder detergent to arrive online. I really wanted to use it right away. It’s so good and has improved my quality of life. I was slightly worried that the drip tray might be inconvenient, but it’s fine. A little water might drip on the soles of your feet when moving dishes from the sink to the dishwasher, but it's fine as long as you're careful. It's also fun, like casting a spell every time you put them in, saying "Get clean, get clean." Anyway, I made a really great purchase. I feel so at ease knowing I don't have to worry about washing dishes in the kitchen cabinet. You absolutely have to buy this! It's a must!

Comments (English): [ Disappointed. Rack design and washing ] || ---------------- || I spent much time researching what I believe to be one of the best dishwasher brands, but I wish I would have spent more time examining this dishwasher's racks and design. Pros: Very quiet operations. You can hardly even hear it running. Cons: . Does not always clean my dishes. Even with the 'old school' clean and rinse before putting dishes into the dishwasher, I have had several items that require a post-dishwasher hand washing. The top rack is practically useless due to the rack design. The useable space is extremely limited. Both sides of the top rack have pre-built grooves front to back which prevents items that are larger than ~1 inch wide (ie; spoon, spatula won't fit). A knife will fit as long as the blade or handle is not too large. The center of the rack can old larger items like a spoon or spatula, but I can only put about 2-3 items in the center section. There is very, very limited clearance between the top of the rack and the top of the dishwasher sprayer. The middle rack sides have very high humps (I call them the cup holder humps). The rack accommodates cups, but when I attempt to put something like a cereal or soup bowl on the top rack sides, due to the high humps in the rack design, the bowls fall over into the center and won't rest or stack in the rack properly. I can only put about 3 bowls on the side or I need to use the center of the middle rack to securely hold something like a cereal or soup bowl. While this is not really a Con, there are 6 wash cycles ie; pro-wash, tough, normal, rinse, etc. Having the \"Normal\" cycle in the first selection position would have made it more convenient to find and select, especially with the small black labels against stainless. The Normal selection is the third selection over. While I still believe that Kitchenaid has one of the best dishwasher brands overall, If it wasn't for the hassle and cost of un-install - re-install, I would return this particular unit and find a design that better fits the type of dishes that we wash most often. I wish I had thought to check on these details in advance

Comments (English): [ Works well, lots of features, still loud ] || ---------------- || Installation was easy, features seem great. I like the adjustable mid-rack and the dedicated silverware top rack seems to get the utensils cleaner than a basket. I paid an upcharge for a Bosch because they touted this as a quiet dishwasher and I work from home and don't want to hear the dishes in the background of all my calls. If it is "quieter" than my old crappy unit, it is only slightly quieter. A "cheap" unit is $500, so at $1000 I was hoping this would be noticeably quieter. I guess their $1600 or $2200 unit is what you need to get in order for it to be a noticeably quieter machine. My brother has a Thermador (Bosch owned brand) that is so quiet I kept opening it while it was running because I couldn't tell it was on. This is NOT that at all.

Our smallest plates still fit, but just a bit more space would have made it perfect.We cross-shopped this with offerings from other retailers, and for the price it seems to check the most boxes. It does come with the Power Control on the lower rack, unlike some 800 series models. I've seen customers give lower ratings for their install experience, and while I get it, clearly this is a local/regional thing that could have a lot of variance. It should be up to Costco to get contracted installers that reflect their company well, but I would guess most people have a good-to-great experience with this. It might be helpful to have separate rating systems for the product and the services included with it. Overall, we are very happy. If we gain any more insights positive or negative I will be back here to update.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is great!
Comments (English): [ Great device, almost too good □□ ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is great! It can be loaded well, the “champagne glass holder” in the lower part on the back is an added value after a girls’ night out, as is the lighting in the interior. There is also a tap counter via the Homeconnect app, remote start, all things that you don’t necessarily need but it works very well. The only thing I have found negative so far is that the machine seems to work so well, or has such good pressure nozzles, that the rings on baby bottles simply spin/fly around on the shelf. Or light plastic children’s cutlery simply flies through the interior due to the high pressure and ends up on the floor. I can’t say whether this is good or bad. It at least indicates a good wash pattern. The rings are now placed in the cutlery drawer and light things such as lids or children’s cutlery remain in the sink when hand-washing. All in all I give the full 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Comments (Original): [ Super Gerät, Fast zu gut □□ ] || ---------------- || Der Geschirrspüler ist super! Lässt sich gut belegen, die „Sektglashalterung“ im Unteren Teil an der Rückseite ist nach nem Frauenabend ein Mehrwert, genauso wie die Beleuchtung im Innenraum. Einen Tapszähler über die Homeconnect App hat man auch, Fernstart, alles Dinge die man nicht unbedingt benötigt aber es funktioniert sehr gut. Einzigste was ich bisher als negativ festgestellt habe, das Gerät arbeitet scheinbar so gut, bzw. hat so gute Druckdüsen, das die Ringe der Baby Trinkflaschen sich einfach auf der Ablage drehen/herum fliegen. Oder leichtes Kinderbesteck aus Kunststoff durch den Hohen Druck einfach durch den Innenraum fliegen und am Ende auf dem Boden wiederzufinden sind. Ob es nun gut oder schlecht ist, kann ich nicht sagen. Es weisst zumindest auf ein gutes Spülbild hin. Die Ringe werden nun in der Bestecklade abgelegt und leichte Dinge wie zb. die Deckel oder Kinderbesteck bleiben eben bei der Handwäsche in der Spüle. Alles zusammen gebe ich die vollen 5 Sterne ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

At first, I didn't know if I needed a dishwasher and just washed dishes by hand, but as I gradually washed dishes with oily dishes, heavy pots, and frying pans, the dishwashing time increased and I got tired a lot, so I bought an LG dishwasher a year ago and am very satisfied with it. My friend's family is also a family of 4, but they didn't plan where to put the space, so they are using a 6-person dishwasher on top, but she said that she still washes dishes by hand because large pots and frying pans don't fit in the dishwasher. Since I've already felt the crispness, True Steam, and fluffy drying of the dishwasher, I really wanted to recommend the LG DIOS dishwasher to my friend and give it as a gift. The size that fits perfectly in the lower cabinet for built-in use and the clean white color are so pretty that I think it will match my friend's interior. Personally, I like the DFE6BG the best. It has a large capacity for 14 people, and it steams and dries cleanly. The color is so pretty.
